focus_areas: Frill integrity and attachment to skull
Separation of ribs and background elements
custom_prompts_for_reflector: The image depicts a fossil skeleton, not a living animal. Please evaluate the checkpoints based on what is physically visible in a skeletal reconstruction. Do not penalize the absence of soft tissue (skin, keratin sheaths) as 'missing parts' unless the prompt implied a fleshed-out reconstruction. Focus heavily on whether the bone structures look like real fossils (porous, weathered) versus AI-smoothed plastic. Ensure the open_vocabulary_detector correctly identifies the horn cores as valid instances of the 'horns' checkpoint.
image_description: A museum display featuring a fossilized Triceratops skeleton. The image focuses on the skull, showing the large bony frill, eye sockets, and beak structure. The rib cage and part of the forelimb are visible to the left. The bones are brownish-tan, set against a dark background with some museum infrastructure visible.
